psychological_meaning: Eastern Blue evokes feelings of tranquility, stability, and trustworthiness. It is often associated with clear communication, intelligence, and efficiency. This color can promote a sense of calm and serenity, while also inspiring confidence and reliability. It is a versatile color that can be both professional and approachable.
